notes.title: Despite the setbacks, our mission is unchanged.
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/800cbcb2a1414dbea64cc6e4ee0c6ec40ec08304.png"][/img][/p][code]\[ REGEN SECURE COMMS LINK ] >>
Thank you for your assistance in our research. Your help is greatly appreciated and the compensation we have provided doesn't begin to match the sacrifice you and your fellow agents have made for the U.S.I.

It appears that the team we sent for the Montano Seed were unsuccessful. Thankfully this time we managed to get some readings. Unfortunately, they don't appear to make any sense. Despite the team deploying to Boreas, we received the data as if it came from Aartis. Our scientists will continue to work on this, we will be in contact if we are in need of any more assistance from Thrace.
[/code][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/b102a9bea758ae35558c3d6ab306e54f7f497247.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][code]\[ RONSON EXECUTIVE CLOSED CHANNEL - 0x0000055A ] >>
Our recent operations both directly, and via our subsidiaries, have improved our integration with the U.S.I. to levels far beyond what we had predicted. We are now in a position to ensure our own contractors are the first options for any future U.S.I. military initiatives.

The speed at which we have achieved this has garnered some unwanted attention from some representatives so we must tread carefully going forward.
[/code]

notes.title: Zombie Assault: Resurgence - Dev Diary #8: Playtest Announcement!
notes.content: [p][img src="http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/73820edc9211c04b48537fc4436f1c15_DevDiary8Reddit.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey mercs![/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with another update on Zombie Assault: Resurgence, and we’ve got something very exciting to share… the next public playtest is just around the corner! We know you’ve all been itching to get your hands on the game again, and we feel like we’re now at the stage where it’s time to get more of your extremely valuable feedback. So, without further ado, here are the details:[/p][p][/p][h1]Playtest Timings[/h1][list][*][p][b]WHEN:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The playtest will begin at [b]10am on August 13th (BST) and run until August 18th (BST)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]WHERE:[/b][/p][list][*][p][url="https://ninja.kiwi/zar_joinplaytest"][u]Steam[/u][/url] - now using the Steam Playtest feature (full details below)![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]What To Expect[/h1][p][/p][p]It has (somehow!) been over 7 months since the first-look playtest, and since then, we’ve been hard at work! Your feedback so far has helped us push forward on the systems, features, and visuals that will bring ZA:R to life, so here’s some of what you’ve got to look forward to for this round of testing:[/p][list][*][p]Drop in to Merc HQ in the all-new multiplayer HUB![/p][/*][*][p]All 3 character classes can now be levelled up to rank 10[/p][/*][*][p]3 epic maps[/p][list][*][p]Mining Facility, Icefield, and Abandoned Colony[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]4 Operation types [/p][list][*][p]Eradication, Eradication Surge, Cache Recovery, and Close the Breach[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tough Mode[/p][list][*][p]A modifier that increases difficulty but also increases rewards[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Varied endings for Operations[/p][list][*][p]Simple, Rush, and Boss[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Strongboxes are back! [/p][list][*][p]These will drop common guns and gear that can be equipped to your characters[/p][/*][*][p]The playtest build will include 10 guns, including starter weapons and a full HVM armour set[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]3 Abilities can be unlocked (final one at rank 10)[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Points gained on level up[/p][list][*][p]Skill Points can be placed into Core and Class Skills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The ability to change equipment on your merc and have multiple saved loadouts[/p][/*][*][p]Canned chat[/p][/*][/list][p]We will also have some of the awesome NK devs jumping in to join the zombie slaying action throughout the testing window, so we’ll post further details on that in our Discord at the time! Also, here’s a little sneak peek at a screenshot from the upcoming playtest build:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/b7316972fbc22b2e39e55912a1155bd9_screenshot_03.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Your Feedback Matters[/h1][p][/p][p]This playtest will help us zero in on some key system designs before we move into deeper content and polish work. Your feedback here is crucial, so here are a few specifics we’d love to get your thoughts on:[/p][list][*][p]The overall look, feel, and difficulty of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Merc HQ performance (especially when there are multiple players in there)[/p][/*][*][p]Gun feel (pros and cons of the various weapons)[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback on initial skills[/p][/*][/list][p]The last time we opened the game up to you all, we were blown away by the feedback and general community discussion, so please join our Discord [url="http://discord.gg/ninjakiwi"][u]here[/u][/url] if you haven’t already to give us your feedback in real-time throughout the testing window, and keep an eye out for a feedback form that we’ll share near the end of the playtest. [/p][p][/p][h1]How to join using Steam Playtest![/h1][p][/p][p]We’re now using Steam’s Playtest feature to make it easier than ever to hop into the action. Here’s how to join:[/p][list][*][p]Head over to the Zombie Assault: Resurgence Steam page [url="https://ninja.kiwi/zar_joinplaytest"][u]here[/u][/url]![/p][/*][*][p]Scroll down to the “Request Access” button under the “Join the Zombie Assault: Resurgence Playtest” section and click it.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam will notify you when you’ve been granted access - no keys needed![/p][/*][*][p]Once access is granted, you’ll be able to install the playtest build straight from your library.[/p][/*][*][p]NOTE: If you took part in the last playtest, you still need to follow these steps to be included in this one[/p][/*][/list][p]Make sure Steam notifications are enabled so you’re notified as soon as the build goes live, and whilst you’re there, [b]be sure to add Zombie Assault: Resurgence to your Wishlist[/b]! [/p][p][/p][h1]Questions from the comments[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will bosses eventually have unique mechanics (phases, environmental hazards, etc)? Will there be more than one boss per map or randomized boss encounters?[/b][/p][p]A: To answer your first question: Yes! These are all things we’re looking to include in boss encounters. Secondly, Operations [i]can[/i] feature randomized boss encounters, while Story missions will be a bit more intentional with any such fights.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will there be mastery ranks, prestige systems, or something to grind for post-cap? Will players be able to freely respec skills or loadouts later on?[/b][/p][p]A: We have lots of fun ideas planned for late-game systems, but for now we’re concentrating on fleshing out the main game feel. Loadouts can be changed as freely as you like. Skills can also be respec’d easily, but will come with an in-game currency cost.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will cosmetics (gun skins, armor variants, etc) be earnable or only monetized? Any plans for visual customization tied to class progression?[/b][/p][p]A: Cosmetics are likely to be a mix of earnable through playing the game and monetized. We are indeed planning on some changes to your appearance tied to class progression![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will bosses have a visible health bar or phase indicator to help players track progress during fights?[/b][/p][p]A: We will have health bars for bosses as well as clear visual feedback for changes in phases. Maybe not in the playtest, but they will be in the final game![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How much of the game is singleplayer-friendly? Will there be a lot of content that's exclusively multiplayer or only balanced around multiplayer?[/b][/p][p]A: The game is being built in such a way that it will be equally playable in multiplayer as it is in single player, so you can choose to slay zombies solo or squad up! [/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this dev diary! The countdown is officially on for the playtest, and we’re so excited for you all to get your hands on the game again. For now, why not whet your appetite by taking part in the latest SAS 4 Global Event starting now for extra juicy rewards! [/p][p][/p][p]Until then; stay alert, mercs![/p][p][i]“The undead are coming home, and they’re bringing all hell with them[/i]” - Anonymous Merc #75[/p]

notes.title: Do Your Part! Final Milestone!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/2abde616949f629474edb1d72bfe1556cf07db5b.png"][/img][/p][code]\[ REGEN SECURE COMMS LINK ] >>

Your work against the zombies is amazing. We couldn't wish for greater partners in these tests. This has confirmed that somehow the zombie populations are being reinforced. Their numbers drop significantly, yet over time we see them climb again. This seems to be only true where the radiation is detected. We had a squad run a controlled outbreak on a remote planet and they were able to wipe out the small zombie population without issue. 

Doing our due diligence, we ran tests of Kurios to be sure. No radiation is being detected on the station.

Going over the old data, we have discovered a team was sent to retrieve the Montano Seed, suspected to be the origin of this strange radiation. We're sending another team to finish this job.

To help them, please continue to control the zombie population. Despite our last transmission, your work is vital to our research and survival as a species.
[/code]

notes.title: Mission Complete!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/797afec9122926837531afd85ff318434b884972.png[/img]
[code][ SAS INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS - 0xC000005 ] >>

Despite our heavy losses, Kurios is ours and our technicians are currently ripping COMBOT’s influence out of the remaining systems onboard. 

USI intelligence has been in contact too. This push against the AI has been a major victory. Its presence in the Mobius sector is still strong but our Fleet has gained a foothold in the system. 

They’ve identified that COMBOT’s stronghold appears to be the AEGIS space station. Hopefully they can learn from what we did here to take AEGIS. 

I wish we could join them, but we’re still quarantined.

<Addendum: SAS force now reduced by 75%>

[/code]

notes.title: Take Back Thrace! Fourth Milestone Achieved!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/eca6908e72f7549c865a581191e262982fa27077.png"][/img][/p][p]Abandoned in the Thrace System, SAS soldiers launch an offensive to secure a safe haven.[/p][p][/p][p]All SAS soldiers must work together to reach the milestones and reap the rewards. [/p][p][/p][p]All mission types contribute toward the goal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30897582/8e83a6b3d2a069dddec166d49ecb9f9537f1c2b9.png"][/img][/p][code]\[ SAS INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS - 0xC0000005 ] >>

Ignore those messages. Combot is running scared. I didn’t know it was possible to scare an A.I. but I’m enjoying the fact that we’ve frightened the hell out of its processes. That’s because we’re winning. We’ve made good progress into the main sphere of Kurios. We’re seeing less zombdroids active in the field. Combot’s having to rely on using the station’s own systems against us. Closing entryways, causing delays while it attempts to shepherd zombies to flank our forces. But we’re wise and our techs are doing a great job from cutting the AI out of a number of systems. Taking back its control over automated turrets is what caused that barrage of misinformation.

Once we take the main control room we have the station.

[/code]

notes.title: Zombie Assault: Resurgence - Dev Diary #1 & First Look Playtest!
notes.content:
[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/8b16fdd262f4492b8597ede87bab12b7_ZAdevdiary1banner.png[/img]
[h1]Dev Diary #1[/h1]
Welcome to our first dev diary for Zombie Assault: Resurgence! Since we announced the game, it has been amazing for the team to see the excitement build around the community and we can’t wait to show you more of what we’ve been working on over the coming months.

As tempting as it is for us to share everything with you now (seriously, we’ve so much we’re excited to show you all), this dev diary is going to focus on explaining the first few game modes that ZA:R will be have to offer, as well as announcing our First Look playtest, happening THIS MONTH! But first, here’s a little snippet of our first-look map, The Mining Facility, to whet your whistle!

[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/a01b23797390144673a91ab8b312a0ad_image47.png[/img]

Prepare to drop in hot in this broiling underground facility and the main base of operations for the mineral miners.

[h1]Game Modes/Characters[/h1]
The First Look playtest will include three awesome game modes. These will be objective-based missions and are as follows (Note: these are not the only modes ZA:R will have - just the first few we’re sharing with you!):

[b]Eradication[/b]

Eradication is a wave-based mode where you must clear out the entire horde of zombies in order to complete the operation. (In-game desc: The Mining Facility is overrun with zombies. Clear the area so the miners can return to work!)

[b]Eradication Surge[/b]

Eradication Surge is a time-based mode with an endless swarm of blood-thirsty zombies. The objective is to survive and take out as many zombies as possible before the timer runs out. (In-game desc: The zombie population in the Mining Facility is growing exponentially. We’re dropping you in hot! Take out as many Zombies as you can before we return!)

[b]Cache Recovery[/b]

Cache Recovery is another time-based mode where packages will spawn around the map and the objective is to recover as many as possible whilst fending off the zombies. (In-game desc: A Cargo Ship of HVM equipment is dropping packages at the wrong coordinates. We only have a limited time, so gather as many as you can!)

[b]Mercenary Classes[/b]

In ZA:R, you’ll have three playable classes to choose from; Assault, Medic and Heavy, each with their own unique abilities specific to their class. There will be much more customisation options when it comes to building your character, but more on that in future dev diaries!

[h1]First Look Playtest[/h1]
So, on to the playtest details! From November 25th (GMT) - November 27th (GMT), we’re going to be running our very first playtest for Zombie Assault: Resurgence on Steam. As we touched on before, this first-look build will be focused on a small segment of what the full version will eventually become, including the one level and three game modes mentioned above, as well as three weapons (a Pistol, an Automatic Rifle, and a Shotgun). The purpose of this test will be to get initial feedback from you all on the look/feel of the game, controls and the overall funness!

To participate in the playtest, please fill out the application form below before midday on Monday, November 18th (GMT). Steam keys will be sent to all participants shortly before the test begins!

SIGN UP HERE - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1RluDaS9sIpfcRQVCmCmnM16hei8GV7QgBEE1E4AZ2OY/


The team is so excited for you to get your hands on ZA in this first look and we can't wait to share more awesome updates in our future dev diaries!

Also, don't forget to join the Zombie Assault: Resurgence official subreddit here - https://www.reddit.com/r/zombieassaultofficial/

notes.title: New Game Announcement - Zombie Assault: Resurgence
notes.content:
[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/5dbf62c3f08acff267fbf2762fa82bd5_AERTJYZFH.png[/img]

We are extremely excited to announce our new game - Zombie Assault: Resurgence - a twin stick horde shooter with RPG elements coming to mobile and PC in 2025!

Set 100 years after the events of SAS: Zombie Assault 4, the Thrace system was lost to zombies and the SAS is no more. The fate of the whole sector now lies in the hands of mercenaries. Select one of three character classes (each with their own special traits, abilities and upgrade trees), make your mercenary stronger with RPG-style upgrades, and build an arsenal of armour and weaponry to give the planet the best chance of survival! 

As is our aim with all Ninja Kiwi games, we’re working hard to make this a fitting sequel to SAS 4, with even more zombie-blasting action, gameplay depth, and replayability. We have already invested tons of development and artist time into the project and the game is shaping up beautifully, so we can’t wait to share more with you! In the coming weeks and months, we plan to share more information via regular developer diaries, as well as beta testing phases, so keep an eye on our socials, Reddit and Discord for any announcements regarding that. 

Join the discussion on our Discord [url=discord.gg/ninjakiwi]here[/url] and subscribe to the Subreddit [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/zombieassaultofficial]here[/url] to keep up to date with the latest on all things Zombie Assault: Resurgence! Watch this… space (get it?)!

notes.title: SAS 4 Update 2.0 is rolling out now - Update Notes!
notes.content:
[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/91536db754ea07c6843ea21685b34d1c_SAS4_2_0_SAS4_LOW.png[/img]
The long-awaited SAS 4 update has finally arrived and it's time to hit the road! An all-new level is waiting on the planet of Montano. 

Jump into the driver’s seat of one of the brand new cars and battle through the abandoned streets fighting hordes of zombies and the new gun-toting Scavenger enemies. Race to retrieve a mysterious artefact from space. Let's roll out!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Map: Recovery
- Available in both normal and nightmare difficulty.
- Also supports Live Events (Apocalypse / Last Man Standing / Virus Samples).
- Added 5 new achievements.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes & Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Made improvements to the Faction War join flow to reduce the number of players receiving an error when trying to join a war.
[*] Fixed the Zero Casualties Achievement not being possible.
[*] Fixed a crash when leaving the coop screen.
[*] Various performance & stability improvements.
[/list]

Let us know your feedback in the comments below and happy gaming! :D

notes.title: SAS 4 Update 1.11 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/3/assets/assets/88a576afd9cb7888a8e1884ea2547062_Faction_Warfare_Update_LOW.png[/img]
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New faction war events will contain 2 new possible game modes:
- Power Up: This facility is suffering major power issues. Morlok’s willing to pay to keep the emergency generators online while technicians offworld try to get the power back on. Be warned, the zombies seem to be destroying any they find. If they destroy too many, we lose the facility.
- Reactor Leak: This facility was conducting tests on the infection. Morlok wants that data but the reactor is in meltdown. Upload the data from as many terminals as you can. They should heal you a little when you activate them.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes & Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where direct damage to bosses was being reduced by 50%.
[*] Weapons that deal direct damage will now deal 100% damage to bosses.
[*] Weapons that deal damage over time (e.g. Stripper, Krakatoa, etc) continue to do the same damage as 1.10.2
[*] To be clear this isn't a nerf to damage over time but a buff to the other weapons.
[*] Reduced Boss HP For Low Level Teams
[*] Fixed Elite Augment Cores not giving enough damage, pierce and damage over time.
[*] Fixed Biosynthesis healing per bullet instead of per zombie death
[*] Fixed damage over time not applying to stunned zombies
[*] Fixed bosses not having temporary immunity to stun after recovering from it
[*] Fixed Adrenaline Skill granting a higher fire speed increase than intended.
[*] Fixed crash on Power Out level
[*] Changed Power Out to allow other types of bosses on Nightmare mode rather than being limited to Savage Mech.
[*] Reduced Krakatoa base damage from 900 to 700
[*] Fixed bug where high damage ammo bonuses were being applied twice to Krakatoa
[*] Fixed bug where Krakatoa would spawn a lava pool per zombie hit rather than per shot.
[*] Added a toggle to the settings screen and pause menu so players can disable screen shake.
[*] Updated the timing for contracts so there should always be at least 1 contract available to play.
[*] We have made improvements to the way we handle loot drops to reduce the chance of loot becoming stuck in areas players couldn’t access. Loot that spawns in areas only accessible by zombies will now be pushed out towards the player.
[*] Fixed a bug where players would gain 1 clip size despite not having any bonuses to clip size.
[*] Fixed bug where Zerfallen and Handekannone could not benefit from faction war clip size bonuses
[*] Faction War Egg Hunt will now spawn zombies after 15s (down from 30s)
[*] Faction War Elimination will now display your kill total during the game.
[*] Fixed missing visuals in the Vaccine arena map for events that would make it look like you could walk through/over the walls.
[*] Fixed some incorrect text in the gun mod expert description.
[*] Various performance improvements.
[/list]

Let us know your thoughts in the comments and happy gaming!
